units.text: To qualify for Veterans Group Life Insurance (VGLI), you must meet at least one of these conditions: 1) You had part-time SGLI as a member of the National Guard or Reserves and suffered an injury or disability while on duty (including direct travel to/from duty) that disqualified you for standard premium rates; 2) You had SGLI while in the military and are within 1 year and 120 days of release from an active-duty period of 31 or more days; 3) You are within 1 year and 120 days of retiring or being released from the Ready Reserves or National Guard; 4) You are within 1 year and 120 days of assignment to the Individual Ready Reserves (IRR) or Inactive National Guard (ING), including the USPHS Inactive Reserve Corps; or 5) You are within 1 year and 120 days of being placed on the Temporary Disability Retirement List (TDRL).

units.reason: The eligibility conditions are directly listed in the VGLI context.

units.text: You must apply within 1 year and 120 days of leaving the military.
supporting_chunk_ids: Veterans’ Group Life Insurance (VGLI) | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The context states 'You'll need to apply for VGLI within one year and 120 days of leaving the military.'

units.text: If you apply within 240 days, you don't need to prove good health; after that, you must submit evidence of good health.
supporting_chunk_ids: Veterans’ Group Life Insurance (VGLI) | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The context states 'If you sign up within 240 days of leaving the military, you won't need to prove you're in good health. If you sign up after the 240-day period, you'll need to submit evidence that you're in good health.'

units.text: Coverage ranges from $10,000 to $400,000 based on your prior SGLI amount.
supporting_chunk_ids: Veterans’ Group Life Insurance (VGLI) | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The context states '$10,000 to $400,000 in life insurance benefits, based on the amount of SGLI coverage you had when you left the military.'
